claim: The framework ships only its own `cb:` graph (`beliefs/beliefs.json`). Worked examples and other collections live in belief-collections (staged at `../belief-collections/`), each with a `manifest.json` declaring its namespace and cross-namespace `depends_on`; the `lib:` lending-library is the gentle on-ramp. Query a collection with `mix bs --beliefs <path>` and verify one against its declared deps with `mix cb.verify.collection <namespace>`.

evidence.detail: Encoded from the framework's hand-written CLAUDE.md into the graph so the file compiles from beliefs via the b042 output-target contract.
